desc: Fix the stack management: use a list and track the leftmost stack element's index with a pointer, avoiding O(n) `pop(0)`.
Correctly calculate the range updates when the max element leaves from the left (restore values to the next max in the stack).
Implement a Fenwick tree (BIT) supporting range add and point query.
Implement the sliding window with monotonic stack and BIT to maintain the non-decreasing cost of the current window.
For each right endpoint r, while the cost exceeds k, move left pointer l and update structures.
Add r - l + 1 to the answer for each r.
Run the test cases to verify correctness, including the provided examples and edge cases. If any test fails, debug the range update logic for the left-side pop and fix the implementation.
Add more random tests comparing against a brute-force O(n²) solution for small n to ensure correctness.
